FlashVSRNode.description: Single-node FlashVSR video upscaling with VRAM-aware processing.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: FlashVSR model version. V1.1 is recommended for stability.

mode.name: Mode
mode.tooltip: Processing mode: tiny is faster, tiny-long is optimized for long videos, and full prioritizes quality.

vae_model.name: VAE Model
vae_model.tooltip: VAE variant used for decoding. Missing VAE files are downloaded automatically.

tiled_vae.name: Tiled VAE
tiled_vae.tooltip: Decode the VAE in spatial tiles to reduce VRAM usage.

seed.tooltip: Random seed used for reproducible noise generation.

enable_debug.name: Debug Logging

keep_models_on_cpu.tooltip: Keep inactive models in CPU RAM to reduce VRAM pressure.
